This drama is set in the Jiufen area from the 1960s to the 1970s. It tells the story of how three brothers conquered the world with their bare hands. Through the love story of the previous generation, it connects the common emotions between the two generations depicting the memories and in-depth exploration of the differences in values between them. 本剧以1960年代至1970年代的九份地区为背景，述说三个拜把兄弟如何赤手空拳打天下，藉由上一代的爱情故事串连与第二代之间共同的情感与记忆，深度探索两代之间的价值观差异。

We always say that Singapore is so boring! But statistics from Singapore Tourism Board suggested otherwise. Just last year, tourists visiting Singapore has increased from 16.4 million to 17.4 million since 2016! You might be sick of the typical places of interest available in Singapore but hey, there’s more to Singapore than you think. Join our tour as we re-introduce Singapore through unique and strictly no trespassing places! 人们常说，新加坡很boring！然而，新加坡旅游局数据却不是这么说！光是去年，入境我国的旅客人数就从前年的1640万人增加到1740万人。谁说新加坡boring的？！或许你已经厌倦了千篇一律的旅游景点，现在是时候让全民动起来，一起出去走走，寻找鲜为人知、闲人勿扰的景点，以独特的视角，重新认识新加坡！

The owner of My One and Only, Ma Limin, aspires to become a real estate developer with her son Hao Renpin, offering one-stop services for property purchase and renovation with her husband Hao Haojian and interior designer Wan Defu, who run How Luck Renovation. Their interactions with their clients reveal stories about different types of families. 马丽敏是“只此一家”的老板娘，怀抱着做发展商的目标，带着儿子郝仁品在地产界闯荡。丈夫郝健和室内设计师万德福负责“好运装修公司”，一家人一起包办客户房屋买卖和装修的需要。透过他们所接待的客户，看到形形色色和“家”有关的故事…
A crisis fixer for the elite pursues the truth of his past, repeatedly crossing moral lines as he descends into the very abyss he seeks to escape. 一个专门为权贵解决危机的神秘男子，在追查过去真相的同时一次次越过道德底线，逐渐走向他最想逃离的深渊。

A half-hour talk-show segment in Hello Singapore which brings together diverse voices and expert opinions to thought-provoking discussions on wide range of issues. Incorporating online polls which gather public opinions, the segment creates a space that allows for multi viewpoints in the studio from Monday to Friday.

Man Wai-sum retired from the media six months ago. With a background in marketing management, Kingston Koo is abruptly appointed as director. Deputy Director Cheung Ka-yin takes over Leung King-yan’s status but struggles to gain the respect of her colleagues. Wai-sum makes a strong comeback as the Queen of News, acquiring the online media platform founded by Lau Yim and challenges conventional mainstream media. 文慧心（佘诗曼饰）退隐新闻界半年，SNK生巨变。市场管理出身的古肇华（黄宗泽饰）空降总监一职，视新闻为赚钱工具；副总监张家妍（李施嬅饰）取代了梁景仁（马国明饰）的地位，纵握大权却难服众。慧心以“新闻女王”姿态强势回归，收购刘艳（王敏奕饰）创办的网媒公开平台，向传统主流媒体发起挑战。KOL唐芷瑶（陈晓华饰）利用自媒体，对慧心展开恶意狙击。

Three generations of the Jin family live under one roof. Mrs. Jin-Ke mei-man has two sons, You-Tsai and You-De. You-Tsai abandoned the family many years ago, leaving his wife Siou-Ying to shoulder the huge responsibility of the Jin family business selling fish products at market. Although Siou-Ying was betrayed by You-Tsai, she has still been a dutiful daughter to her mother-in-law, and has single-mindedly raised four children. 三代同堂的金家，奶奶金柯美满，膝下有两子-有财跟有德。有财早年抛弃家庭离开，妻子秀英一肩扛下金家重责大任，在市场从事贩卖鱼货的工作。虽然有财对不起秀英在先，但秀英仍然孝顺婆婆，也拉拔彦钧等四个孩子长大。透过金家的故事，除了体会婚姻的酸与甜，还得面对婆媳、姑嫂、妯娌间的「那些小事」…，也透视到家庭与爱情真正爱的真谛！

p.d: After his release from prison, Shigeo loses his memory in a brutal attack. Taken in by Kasumi, he becomes the lead singer of a band and lives a new life- until memories of his dark past begin to return.

Lincoln Jefferson, an Iraqi War veteran, working as a school janitor tries to mend his relationship with his son after a divorce. When his son is killed by a police officer found innocent without standing trial, he takes matters into his own hands.

Anja and Frank are holidaying by the Baltic Sea with their two children. Anja leaves them alone for a while, but upon return, they are nowhere in sight. While searching for them, Anja discovers that Frank has never told her the truth about his father.

After a celebration in her rural hometown, Karla Petersen is murdered on her way home. Inspector Helen Dorn takes on the case but clashes with local officer Tom Petersen, Karla's brother, who defies warnings to find his sister's killer.

Ranging from a 60-year-old retiree who no longer finds herself desirable to a daughter trying to make her breakthrough as a model, five women of different ages confront their self-image and the expectation they have for themselves and the people around them.

Princess Khutulun, a formidable Mongol warrior descended from Genghis Khan, has her marriage ambushed by an assassin who steals the Golden Sutra. Vowing revenge, Khutulun and her clan set out on an epic journey to retrieve the sacred text and restore peace.
When Professor Marcelo Pena finally is about to be appointed Head of the Philosophy Department, the famous and seductive Professor Sujarchuk returns from Europe to claim the kingdom for himself.

In a bid to sneak into the Tonga vs France rugby match, superfan Maka invents a fake band to perform for the pre-game show. With the match coming soon, Maka and his friends have four weeks to come up with a performance

Xia Tian relocates to her hometown to care for her dad, who suffered from Alzheimer for over a decade. She thought it would help her parents. However, as the disease worsens, she has to face the pressure of life. And the only thing she can do is to wait.

In an illegal arms case, three men, including two policemen, are dead. Mattheisen reveals a radical right-wing conspiracy, and suspects a mole. However, he is shot dead with Inspector Dorn’s weapon, while Dorn is found at the crime scene with no memory.

A former footballer and jailbird, Ivo is no longer interested in football. That is until he meets Lukas, a talented young player, and decides to help him pursue a professional career. But his criminal past soon catches up with him.
When Travis, a self-isolated recluse with low-grade cerebral palsy and anger management issues falls for Sunny, an unassuming comedian, he must take the stage to show his true self and win her love.

Twice a year, Asia’s coastlines enter a brief, rare window of extraordinary equinox “king tides” where the Sun, Moon and Earth align and the sea surges beyond its usual limits. In that short period, homes, sea walls, livelihoods and ecosystems are stress-tested and the shoreline becomes a moving border. Tides of Time is a three-part series narrated by BAFTA-nominated presenter and Sunday Times best-selling author Ben Fogle. Filmed in Bangladesh, China and South Korea, the team chases this celestial trigger along three epic shores where water doesn’t just rise but rewrites the communities’ destinies. From Sundarbans’ Hanging Homes Village, to China’s Qiantang “Silver Dragon” tidal bore, to Korea’s getbol mudflats, each film is a human rendezvous with the tide where humans must choose to adapt, resist or surrender.
From business to politics, health to technology, the latest news from Singapore and analysis of the impact.

In an age where loneliness is common and connection feels like currency, a new kind of companion has arrived on the market: the AI chatbot. Always awake, always responsive, always affirming. But how much of a real friend or companion can something digital ever be? Our series follows four individuals here in Singapore – different in age, culture, circumstance, yet united by a willingness to explore something different. Over the course of two weeks, each participant shapes their own “ideal” AI companion and introduces it into their life. We witness the ups and downs of these encounters, examining and analysing emotional motivations and algorithmic responses with experts ranging from relationship coaches to AI developers. In the end, the question is: Can AI really fill that human space where a friend or a companion should be?
